authority: O41 per-file implementation; R7 task/connector invariant refinement
scope: one admitted task's in-memory cancellation request versus actual-work-end record; NOT cancellation driver, task admission, owner authentication, resource drain or effect outcome

ownership.root: created once per actual task by trusted coordinator; never per watcher/document lease
ownership.requesterView: requestCancellation and immutable snapshot only; cannot report completion
ownership.reporterView: only trusted execution-chain owner holds reportActualEnd; no external caller-supplied stop boolean
ownership.handoff: JS/HTTP reply handing work to native persistence is NOT whole task work ended; verify all live owners/writers before reporting

transitions: first request before end atomically sets requested=true only
requests after end are no-op ALREADY_ENDED, never rewrite original snapshot
first actual end wins; duplicate/conflicting later reports return false without rewriting
request flag survives natural return/failure; cancellation request never changes end kind to STOP_CONFIRMED
concurrency: immutable snapshot in single AtomicReference; linearizable monotonic transitions; no callbacks, executor creation, reset, clocks or persistent state
effectAndDurability: actual execution chain ending is independent from cloud effect known/unknown and persistence committed/failed; this primitive must not report domain success or quiescence
tests: request-vs-end and conflicting-end races with bounded real HOST threads
real HOST Future.cancel returns done while interrupted worker continues, end remains unset until worker finally exits
integrationGate: TaskCoordinator must separately validate exact original work owner/epoch, live-writer chain and publication fence; do not accept Reporter or snapshots from IPC and do not release budgets on request alone
